T: Romance novel. Real jungle. Big lunch.
D: A romance writer is kidnapped by a billionaire who thinks she can find a lost treasure, and her cover model goes to rescue her.
P: Serve the snacks when Loretta and Alan finally get out of the jungle.
S: Loretta's book tour in the sequinned jumpsuit
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and thin prosciutto wrapped around wedges of rockmelon, laid out on trays for the launch crowd.
the jungle on the remote island
Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit in cups with lime and a pinch of chilli salt.
Alan, the cover model with the flowing hair
Prawns dipped in egg and shredded coconut, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli sauce.
M: the tropical island in the Atlantic
Snapper fillets rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled in banana leaves, with coconut rice and black beans.
Fairfax, the spoilt billionaire who kidnaps Loretta
Beef eye fillet seared all over and roasted at 220C to medium-rare, rested and sliced, with a béarnaise of yolks, butter and tarragon, crispy potatoes and asparagus.
W: the crown of fire everyone is chasing
Ripe mango, lime juice and sugar syrup blended smooth, frozen in a tray and scraped every hour until set, scooped into glasses with passionfruit on top.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime over ice with mint.

s.note: Loretta's book tour in the sequinned jumpsuit
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and snipped chives. Cut a rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a thin slice of prosciutto. Lay both out on trays in rows for the book launch crowd.

s.note: Alan, the cover model with the flowing hair
s.how: Peel 500g green prawns, leaving the tails on. Dip each in beaten egg, then press into a mix of shredded coconut and panko breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain on paper and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.

m.note: the tropical island in the Atlantic
m.how: Rub 4 snapper fillets with lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt, and warm a can of black beans. Serve the fish in its leaf.

w.note: the crown of fire everyone is chasing
w.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with the syrup and the juice of 2 limes until smooth. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Scoop into glasses and top with passionfruit pulp.

d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir well and serve cold, the kind of drink you need after hiking out of a jungle.
